subject: GaterNet status: exact repro, edge latency concern
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Status. Repro is exact: our eval of the released ResNet-20-Gated and ResNet-56-Gated checkpoints on CIFAR-10 matches the paper numbers, running main.py with backbone-depth 20 and 56 respectively.

Gating analysis on the internal workload port: the gater deactivates about 35% of filters on average, and the selection is genuinely input-dependent — easy inputs gate off up to 50%.

The risk Rafael flagged: the architecture literally looks twice — the gater network runs a full forward pass before the backbone does, so wall-clock latency on our edge tier is worse than the static baseline even when FLOPs drop. Unless the gater can run on a downsampled input, the edge story does not close.

Rosa
